entries.objective: The student should be able to: I. Identify concentric zones of the earth.
entries.sub_topic: The earth' s crust, the mantle, the core and their respective characteristi es.
entries.teaching_act: By using a model of internal structure of the earth/diagrams, the teacher to guide students in groups to observe and identify the zones (the crust, the mantle and the core) of the earth. To guide students to clarify on the concentric zones of the earth. To guide the students to draw and label the concentric zones of the earth. To assign students to read written materials on structure of the earth and collect information for variation of density and thickness of zones.
entries.learning_act: i) students to read written materials on structure of the earth and collect information for variation of density and thickness of zones.
entries.references: T.I.E (2021). Geography For Secondary Schools. Students Book Form Three. Dar es Salaam .

entries.objective: 2. Explain the mode of formation for each type of rocks and their economic importance.

To guide each group to discuss, present and make summary of mode of formation and economic importance of rocks.
